nodes.name: Agent Safety Principles.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-008) defining the multi-layer safety guidance for autonomous trading agents: credential isolation, self-verification, phased autonomy, an AI-specific risk taxonomy, human oversight, and fail-safe defaults. Cross-cuts all systems and motivates constraint nodes and the paper-trading gate.
nodes.languageNotes: dev_graph knowledge_asset with ontology frontmatter; informs ADR - Implementation Substrate and the Context Map architecture node.

nodes.name: CQRS.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-002) defining Command Query Responsibility Segregation as the principle separating the read model (Layer 2 snapshots) from the write model (Layer 3 order execution). Justifies the analysis/execution split and eventual consistency of snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Ontology Redesign and both the Layer Model and Context Map architecture nodes.

nodes.name: Context Engineering.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-007) defining context engineering — treating finite LLM context windows as a budgeted resource managed via typed retrieval, admissibility gates, and intent-aware routing. Motivates the Context Assembly capability and the dev_graph as a structured retrieval substrate.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Ontology Redesign and the Context Map architecture node.

nodes.name: Event Sourcing.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-001) defining event sourcing — capturing state changes as an immutable sequence of domain events with state derived by replay. Justifies the event-driven runtime topology, trade-log audit trail, and versioned domain events.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Ontology Redesign and the Runtime Topology architecture node.

nodes.name: Guardrail Philosophy.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-005) defining the guardrail philosophy — hard, externally enforced constraints the agent cannot reason around, separating non-negotiable hard limits from configurable soft limits. Motivates the Guardrail Pattern, the Risk Control boundary, and the Trade Validation Gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Implementation Substrate and the Context Map architecture node; constrained by No Wiki Mutation.

nodes.name: Layer 2 Design Principles.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-006) defining the principles governing the Layer 2 snapshot system — the deterministic, self-contained, point-in-time analytical truth layer between L1 ingestion and L3 execution. Motivates the Snapshot Assembly capability and the Layer 2 Snapshot Schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Decision Layer Re-grounding and both the Layer Model and Context Map architecture nodes; source of the Regime Taxonomy asset.

nodes.name: Office Action Methodology.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-004) defining the office-action methodology — governing autonomous agent interventions through a deterministic state machine (baseline -> diagnosis -> approval -> evaluation) with integration checkpoints, audit-by-design, and graceful degradation. Motivates the Office Action Loop workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Methodology-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Decision Layer Re-grounding and the Context Map architecture node.

nodes.name: Paper Trading Validation.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-010) defining paper-trading validation — the mandatory simulated-execution stage with real market data and virtual capital that generates quantitative evidence justifying promotion to live trading. Motivates the Evaluation Loop Pattern and Paper Trading Promotion Gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Methodology-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Gold DecisionPacket v0 Planning and the Context Map architecture node.

nodes.name: Regime Taxonomy.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-011) defining the regime taxonomy — a small, deterministic, enumerated set of snapshot-local market-regime labels sitting between raw features and trade-decision logic. Motivates the Market Regime Classification capability and the Regime Classification Pattern.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; justified by ADR - Deterministic Regime Taxonomy and originates from Layer 2 Design Principles; informs the Market Regime Classification architecture node.

nodes.name: Stateless Agent Architecture.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-009) defining stateless-agent architecture — each invocation starts with zero state and reconstructs continuity from persistent files via a Wake-Execute-Sleep cycle with git as the persistence layer. Motivates the Agent Runtime system and file-based memory architecture.
nodes.languageNotes: Principle-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Ontology Redesign and ADR - Paper-Trading Runtime Planning; used by the Context Map, Paper-Trading Runtime, and Paper-Trade Admission nodes.

nodes.name: Supervisor Pattern Methodology.md
nodes.summary: Knowledge-asset node (KA-003) defining the supervisor-pattern methodology — a resource-constrained meta-agent that assembles, evaluates, and upgrades a team of specialized worker agents under treasury limits, where the supervisor itself is the product. Motivates the Supervisor Office system and Office Action Loop workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Methodology-type knowledge_asset; informs ADR - Decision Layer Re-grounding and the Context Map architecture node.
